## Description
A trusted source-pinned **Staging-merged-SHA Full E2E** run [#43220028773/1](https://github.com/BestNathan/nession/actions/runs/43220028773), target `bb72bf3a70542f7514b814967a670fd03474ffdb`, completed Playwright itself with exit 0 but correctly **failed** the strict per-ID verifier (`full Playwright report is not an all-Pass run`). The GitHub-uploaded original Playwright report, artifact `13947670960`, proves **477 expected, 0 unexpected, 0 skipped, 2 flaky**. Both retries passed only on second execution, so do not mark the run Pass.

## Impact
Flaky Select geometry measurements block reliable CI signals for the `project-session-create` regression and prevent acceptance of parent #3200. Without stabilization, transient measurement failures can mask real UI positioning defects or force repeated manual re-runs, degrading trust in the strict Full zero-flaky Gate.

## Reproduction
- `project-session-create.spec.ts:130`, `Existing Location Select contains a long path at 1440`: first attempt `selectAnchor.ts:102`, popup start x=431.200012, trigger x=416, difference 15.2 CSS px (required ≤2); retry passed.
- `project-session-create.spec.ts:185`, same case at 1024: first attempt `selectAnchor.ts:31`, popup `boundingBox()` was temporarily null while geometry was being measured; retry passed.
- Other E2E IDs including `terminal-io` did not fail. This is not the original #3200 WebSocket regression. Preserve #3246's strict trigger-to-popup alignment and popup visibility/overflow checks.

## Root Cause
The shared browser geometry helper `e2e/helpers/selectAnchor.ts` settles **only the popup box** after a single visible-state check, then measures the trigger separately. During asynchronous Dialog/portal layout or open animations, these can be sampled at different states. An intermediate unavailable popup or misaligned pair should be retried **within a bounded settled-layout expectation**; a persistently misaligned dropdown or vanished popup must still FAIL. The second-attempt passes alone do not prove there is no actual product defect; keep the exact measured contract unchanged, investigate product positioning separately if stabilized geometry remains wrong.

## Fix Direction
1. Change only the shared anchor verification to await a coherent, settled trigger/popup geometry using bounded Playwright polling/retry; do not increase the 2px horizontal tolerance or sideOffset tolerance, remove any geometry assertion, skip scenarios, or weaken Full.
2. Retain 1440/1180/1024/390, pointer/keyboard/reopen checks, long text wrapping and option overflow assertions in `project-session-create.spec.ts`.
3. Run authenticated exact-head browser `project-session-create` E2E and relevant CI Gates. Follow with a new exact-source canonical Full with 0 failed, 0 skipped, 0 flaky; a retried individual test alone is not final acceptance for parent #3200.
4. If the popup remains displaced after a settled deadline, treat as a real UI defect and fix the canonical `web/src/components/ui/select.tsx` owner instead of weakening this E2E contract.

## Location
`e2e/helpers/selectAnchor.ts`, source `e2e/tests/browser/project-session-create.spec.ts` (existing ID).

## Success Criteria
- [ ] SC-01 The shared helper explicitly waits for measurable settled popup + trigger and exact unchanged anchor/offset/viewport conditions, tolerating only transient measurement unavailability; a stable 15px misplaced popup still fails.
- [ ] SC-02 The existing `project-session-create` CI browser regression passes with all four viewports and original exact alignment, plus the project's strict Full zero-failed/skipped/flaky qualification at a fresh integration SHA.

**SC → scenario:** SC-01=SCN-01 static/geometry helper contract + CI; SC-02=SCN-02 browser E2E / SCN-05 exact Full source attestation. CI browser runtime required.
